recipes.name: Zucchini Bread with Cinnamon Sugar Topping

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Coat two 9x5-inch loaf pans with cooking spray.
Combine white sugar, zucchini, oil, eggs, and vanilla in a large bowl; stir in raisins.

Combine flour, baking soda, salt, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, and baking powder in a separate large bowl; whisk into zucchini mixture until almost no lumps remain. Divide batter between the prepared loaf pans.
Whisk brown sugar and ¼ teaspoon cinnamon together in a small bowl until well combined; sprinkle over batter in the loaf pans.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into centers comes out clean, about 1 hour. Cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then remove from the pans and finish cooling on a wire rack.

raw_recipe.headline: Zucchini Bread with Cinnamon Sugar Topping
raw_recipe.description: Different toppings for zucchini bread can take an ordinary loaf recipe and knock it out of the park, like this simple cinnamon and brown sugar topping.

review.reviewBody: I cut this recipe back to 12 servings and made muffins out of the batter. Instead of vegetable oil, I used melted butter. I cut the melted butter by half and substituted homemade applesauce for the other half. I also increased the baking powder/baking soda and cinnamon to a teaspoon each and I used organic raisins. Very good zucchini bread recipe--very moist and slightly chewy. We really liked the cinnamon sugar topping but there needed to be a little more. We'll increase it next time. I think I'll add a half cup of pecans next time, too, as one of the other reviewer's suggested.

I have made this recipe 3 times and we just love it! The topping really adds to it. I have ended up using pureed zucchini (instead of shredded) because my Ninja is only able to puree now...I was really concerned this would not turn out, but it has been working great. Really moist and wonderful! It is a bit more like a pumpkin bread texture this way. My family is requesting more as soon as the loaf is gone!

I made two loaf pans and forgot to put the topping in the middle..but I added it to the top and swirled it in, and then added more on top of the loaves...I doubled the topping..it was great I had no yellow raisins so just used regular and some chopped nuts...it was great...will def make again..
The brown sugar/cinnamon topping makes this special. I'm making mine into more of a Breakfast Bread by adding some flax meal (1/4 c), sunflower seeds and 2 shredded carrots.

So good! I made it the first time as written (except raisins). The 2nd time I subbed half the oil for applesauce and used 1 cup of regular sugar and 1 cup of Splenda brown sugar and I couldn't tell the difference. Coworkers keep asking me to bring this bread in again!
Edit: After making this several times, I couldn't figure out why the loaves were so flat. It's not enough batter for regular loaf pans. Today I upped the recipe by half and came out with 2 beautiful, rounded loaves!

This zucchini bread was very good. I made this as written with the exception of omitting the golden raisins and adding a cup of chopped walnuts. I would make the following changes next time. I’d try adding another cup of zucchini and increase the cinnamon in the batter to 2 t. And I would increase the brown sugar topping probably by half. The recipe didn’t specify what size loaf pans to use and there are a lot of different sizes out there. A word of caution – don’t use two 9x5” loaf pans like I did! You will end up with very short, squatty loaves. Mine probably were only about 1 3/4” high – a big disappointment. I would think 8 1/2x4 1/2” pans would be more appropriate for this recipe. I would definitely make this again, with my tweaks, and use smaller pans!

Amazing! Squeezed the zucchini after grating, used 1/2 cup lite butter & 1/2 cup applesauce instead of oil. Used 1 cup Splenda & 1 cup brown packed sugar instead if all white sugar. Heavy on the cinnamon. 1 1:2

only substitute I made was 1 to 1 GF flour . absolutely delicious. also made a 2nd batch w dark chocolate and extra spices and shredded carrots which was also super yummy and a definite go to. you've gotta make this zucchini bread!

I added 1/2 cup of walnuts and used 2 tsps. of cinnamon in the batter and added an extra 1/4 tsp. cinnamon to the topping. I baked the loaves for an extra 15 minutes but should have only added 5 or 10 minutes.

I thought this was good bread but might have been better with a sprinkle or two of nutmeg and/or ginger. I used a half cup of coconut oil and a half cup of applesauce in place of the vegetable oil. I omitted the raisins though I put a quarter cup of chocolate chips in one of the loaves. The topping is a nice touch!
I left out the raisins, & I doubled the streusel topping and added a layer of it in the middle of the bread...heavenly!! :)

Easy to make, nice and moist. I substituted half of the oil with homemade applesauce and added about a half cup of walnuts. My hubby said it’s perfect but I think it needs more flavor so next time I’ll add more cinnamon. I think the topping was good, but not enough.
I used 1 cup of Stevia & 1 cup sugar. Added a cup of chopped walnuts and it turned out amazing. My husband loves it and I'll make it again!

I made this without any changes (except for leaving out the raisins). Easy to make, texture great, flavor good but a bit bland. Next time I'll add some grated orange rings for a bit of a punch. Otherwise, excellent.
Very bland even with the cinnamon and sugar topping. I didn't add nuts but I don't think it would have made a difference. Maybe use some brown sugar next time....if I make it again, but not likely.
Recipe was easy to follow, and the bread is delicious and moist. The crumble top gives it a nice crisp glaze like coating. Its good but I would try a cinnamon streusel topping instead.
Great recipe. I added nutmeg, pecans, and cranberries to the mix. Healthy and taste great!

I made the 1st batch following directions (except raisins)then made a 2nd batch and added pecans and extra cinnamon and glazed the top with a cinnamon,butter and brown sugar glaze. The tweaked one had more flavor and disappeared fast.
